description:
Create a transparent sprite atlas of 24 separate fantasy RPG status icons, EXACTLY 3 columns by 8 rows. Canvas384x512: each cell128x64; centers x64,192,320 and y32,96,160,224,288,352,416,480. One compact icon inside each cell, maximum48x48, empty transparent margins. No text, labels, letters, grid, frame, background, pedestal, badges or UI circles. Match reference game sprite: hand-drawn pixel-art miniature, crisp clustered pixels, dark local contour, clear 3-tone sculpted light/shadow, cool steel, worn leather, restrained colors, modest highlights. Recognizable solid objects and materials, not flat vector symbols, not glossy mobile icons. Top-left light, subtle 3/4 volume. Each row: same effect, three motifs A/B/C left to right. Rows top to bottom:
1 SPIKES: A three steel spikes; B four-point steel caltrop; C scattered caltrops on tiny patch of ground.
2 CORPSE bone cream/brown: A lifeless horizontal body on ground; B skull beside prone body under torn cloth; C skull and ribcage lying on ground. NO green poison skull or upright living person.
3 COLLAPSE WARNING: A cracked floor slab shedding fragments; B floor diamond splitting over dark hole; C broken ledge with falling stones.
4 FLOOR TRAP: A bronze pressure plate with emerging steel spikes; B triggered pressure tile with spring mechanism; C open mechanical jaw trap on floor.
5 WALL TRAP: A stone wall socket firing bolt sideways; B recessed wall spikes protruding sideways; C wall slit with flying arrow.
6 DEEP ACID lethal lime: A head and hands sinking into green acid; B skeletal hand disappearing in acidic pool; C boot sinking below bubbling green liquid.
7 VOID: A black opening with jagged stone rim; B broken floor ledges framing dark chasm; C missing floor tile exposing black abyss. Empty center, not stone cube.
8 GENERIC HAZARD: A weathered ochre warning triangle with exclamation mark; B bone skull on dangerous ground; C boot halted at jagged deadly ground edge.
